content: Shilǝn ki Lya ki Yahaya Mul Baptisma
Gopti shilǝn ki Yesu almasihu, yakǝn ki Lya kǝnngu.
Kan u nǝɗa ki laci ge' lwatbati ki Ishaya mulnjeshinkǝn u, ti ussu, “In ngu an shin mulshinkǝn i ni tǝnnda kina, mulnǝ ti likǝni ki shitu u.
Yal mul tati bi age' dǝlgǝn ti ussu, likǝni Lya shitu nǝ mbatldlwakǝn, likǝnǝ shituwasi.”
Yahaya mul baptisma mbi gawasi ge' dǝlgǝn, ti dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya, “Tǝ mbalǝn za pǝl bezǝn lǝɓa a pǝlsi baptisma tingaki tǝ pacisi bezǝn lǝɓa wasǝn ɗa.”
Mbalǝn ki galt ki Yahudiya nǝ kum mbalǝn ki Ulushalima is go' mbǝ' mati, a si dlǝp bezan lǝɓa u nǝs pǝli u, i pǝlsi baptisma a dlilka ki Uldun.
Yahaya ti nǝ ulki laki a dli ki medlǝn ki Lakumi, nǝ ulkǝndǝdlom ki bati amisi, ulki ɗami wasi zhita nǝ mal du.
Ati dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya, i' usu, “Mulǝn ɗǝ mbǝti ge kalini mul nalti ngǝdlǝni, zhim kaptalan wasi ambǝci ta ngusi a ɓatli wai.
A miɓo ge mal kǝn ami pǝlikin baptisma, tiɓo nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ki zeki ti pǝlikini.”
A pǝli Yesu Baptisma
Nǝgu dǝmi Yesu i' mbǝ te' Nazillat ge atl ki Galili, i Yahaya pǝli' baptisma a dlilka ki Uldun.
Ɗǝ petuwasi to' ge mali i' en lya abuli, i Yal ki mbatl ki Lya pesul lya kǝnǝ kulu.
I kum yalon sul lya ɗǝ ussu, “Kiki yakuyini gunǝ ami lyamti, nǝti ami holtugi iye.”
Shedan Cibǝl Yesu
Alǝbi alǝbi i Yalkimbatl ki Lya dloti i' te' ge' dǝlgǝn,
A tiki dǝmi, mutti kutl kutl lǝbi upsi, a Shedan ɗǝ cibǝlti, atine' tlu kige' dǝlgǝn a mi' shinkǝnki Lya ɗǝ pǝlliti kyautǝn.
Yesu Gop Kyautǝn Wasi a Galili
Kalki dlǝl Yahaya, I Yesu te ge' atli ki Galili, ati dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya.
Ati ussu “Cini apoyi gunki Lya ɓalnja i. Zakǝn pǝtl byazǝn lǝɓa ndǝnǝ nǝ shilǝn ki Lya.”
Yesu Taki Mi' Lati Lekku Bi Gudul Upsi
Ati ɓeuti abi dlilka ki Galili, i' en ki Bitlus nǝ Andalawus yelse wasi, asi lati lekku a dlilka tǝngaki si mi' gopti Kes kǝnǝ.
I Yesu ulsisu “bǝlǝnnǝn kali, an palkini adǝmni mi' ngau mbalǝn.”
Alǝbi alǝbi is za lati lekku wasǝn is bǝlti kali.
Nǝs ɓeu kina ten i' en Yakubu nǝ yelse wasi Yahaya, mil ki Zabadi, a ge Kudǝlǝn ki mali asi likǝ' lekku.
Nǝ' takisi bi'u Alǝbi alǝbi is bǝlti kali. Is za bwaswasǝn Zabadi age Kudǝlǝn ne' mil pǝliti kyautǝn.
Mul Du Mi'gadli
Is tege gatl ki Kapalnahum cin shuti, i' Yesu tege lu dopga ki Yahudawa ati kulcisi shǝlǝn ki Lya ɗaɗanu.
Is en ulki gagashinti tǝn ulnǝ ti kulcissi u, tǝn gaki ti kulcissi kǝnǝ gunǝ ti kumti nǝ ndǝlton u, bǝ kǝnǝ mi' lashti zhil ki Musa wai.
Mulǝn ɗa, mul du mi'gatli a ge'lu dopga wasǝn, i' la yali,
I' usu, “Yalamineki Yesu yakǝn nazalet? Ki mbǝni ki hwotimi bezǝn lǝɓa ya? A manini ki wokǝni, ki yakǝn ki Lya mul zo'mbadl kǝni!”
I Yesu mati mi'gatli ki geti, i' usu, “Dǝm shot! Pe' ɗǝ ge mulu!”
I ki i bezǝn mi'gatli i' u mulisi. I' la yali, i' petaka geti.
Kum mbalǝn en ulki gagashinti, is go' gyep yelsǝni, a si u'su, “Yakǝn nǝgu u? A sǝti pyal kushti won ngǝ! Mulu tinǝ ndǝtl ki pi' du mi'gatliyi shilǝn, a si kup shilǝn wasi!”
Alǝbi alǝbi shilǝnni zǝga ko una ge' atl ki Galili.
Yesu Ndokǝl Kom Ki Bitlus
Nǝ petwasǝn ge' lu dopga ki Yahudawa, ki Yakubu nǝ Yahaya is te libi ki Bitlus nǝ Andalawus.
Kom ki Bitlus ki muɗi atli ti gonti, nǝ te ki Yesu, is piti.
I' lǝ mati, i' gopi' toh i' tliltilya, i' ndoki, i' hilya ma i' pǝlisi kyautǝn.
Yesu Ndokǝl Mbalǝn Diɓǝli a Suti
A suti, kalki ki nda ki cin, is mbǝlli Yesu mi' gonti, nǝ mil mi'gatli.
I mbalǝn ki ge' gatli kup si domga a kina dlabi.
I' ndokǝl mbalǝn diɓǝli, ko wongi nǝ unndi gontuwasi, iki pe'kǝl mil mi'gatli diɓǝlli. Ta ndǝgi tǝ mi'gatli shilǝn wai, tǝn gaki simanǝnti.
Yesu Zǝga ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya
Nǝ kyau, balu a pa' ciltuwai, I Yesu hilya i' peki, i' zǝga gelu u nǝ bǝ mbalǝn ɗawai u, i' zǝga ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya tyaka
I Siman nǝ mbalǝn u nǝ tinesi u is zǝga ɗǝ ngauti.
Nǝs mbitu, is ultisu, “kup mbalǝn ɗǝ ngauki.”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Mǝlǝn ge' gatlu gunǝ kina u, ta dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya ɗa ɗanu. Ulnǝ laki yambǝɗa ungu.”
I kup ti tya'tya ge' atl ki Galili a ti dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya a ge' lu dopga ki Yahudawa, a ti pyakǝli' mbalǝn mi'gatli.
Yesu Ndokǝl Mul Go' Ki Dakǝlti
Mul go' ki dakǝlti i'mbǝ ma Yesu, i' ngusiti i'ngemti, a ti ussu, “Inka ndǝgu, kin ma'paltǝn mul lǝshi ɗa'ti.
I ci' gontuwasi gop Yesu, i' ta toh wasi i' tǝnti, i' ultisu, a ndǝgi, a ndokǝlki, dǝmi mul lǝshi ɗati!”
Alǝbi alǝbi i dakǝltisi zati, i' dǝm mul lǝshi ɗati.
I ki i Yesu pi' shilǝn mul ndǝlti, nǝ tǝs zǝga u.
I' ultisu, “Bǝ pi mullǝn wai. Mǝllǝ le' en lǝɓa, a bǝl Lya ulki okǝtl bezǝn lǝɓa kanwunǝ Musa dlǝmi u tǝn gaki wokǝlti. Pǝli nǝgu tǝngaki tǝ mbalǝn mani ɗa ka ndoki.”

Ge' shuki nǝgu, i muli peki i go' dlǝp shilǝnni tyai. I gu la Yesu ta man te' ge gatlon a dwaɗǝn ɗǝ ye' dwaɗǝnwai, i' go' dǝp gelu u nǝ mbalǝn ɗa wai u. Ngo nǝ nǝgu, mbalǝn go' mbǝ mati, te' ge lu en.
